name: grok-beta

lifecycle.note: xAI has published no deprecation or retirement notice for grok-beta or grok-vision-beta; the xAI API models page lists neither (checked 2026-10-01).

released.note: Released on the xAI API at the start of its public beta; the release notes date the API public beta to Nov 4 (2024) but do not name the model.

summary.text: grok-beta is a preview language model that xAI offered on its API from the start of the API public beta on 4 November 2024, as the provisional name of a new Grok model in the final stages of development. xAI gave it a 128,000-token context window and function calling; a multimodal version with image input, grok-vision-beta, followed as a preview.

inputModalities.note: The API post calls grok-beta the text-only version.

variants.name: grok-vision-beta

inputModalities.note: Announced as a multimodal version of grok-beta that can ingest images.

variants.note: The API post of 2024-11-04 announced the vision model for the following week; the December 2024 post confirms it had been released as a preview model. No day is given.

notes: Added beyond the planned scope. xAI released grok-beta as the provisional name of a preview of a new Grok model that was in the final stages of development; it did not say later which named model this became, so no relation is recorded. Categories include multimodal because of the inline vision variant. The December 2024 post calls grok-beta and grok-vision-beta preview models.
